frames.headline: Somebody Signed For The Last Delivery. Nobody Can Tell You Who.
frames.sub: Every litre that leaves a depot has a name against it. Most fleets cannot produce the name.

frames.headline: Four Things To Check Before You Sign
frames.sub: The driver waits. That is the whole point of the meter.
list: Meter reads zero before the hose moves
Signature and time on both copies
frames.kicker: Save this for the next delivery.
